title: Style: cinematic retro sci-fi, inspired by grand 1970s/80s space films…
content:
Style: cinematic retro sci-fi, inspired by grand 1970s/80s space films, practical effects, symmetrical compositions, slow deliberate camera movement, cream-and-chrome spaceship interiors, big buttons, glowing panels, analog readouts, subtle film grain, soft haze, dramatic but thoughtful mood. Captain HaHaa has charm, swagger, and warmth. He walks through his ship while delivering a reflective monologue in a confident Australian accent. The tone is philosophical but grounded, ending hopeful and personal.

SHOT 1 - 0:00-0:05

Visual: Wide symmetrical shot of a long cream-and-chrome spaceship corridor with glowing wall panels, blinking buttons, and retro consoles built into the walls. Captain HaHaa walks slowly toward camera from the far end, hands loosely behind his back at first, calm and reflective.

Camera: Slow centered dolly backward, very smooth, stately and elegant.

Dialogue: “Well, here we are, mates, a brand-new age.”

SHOT 2 - 0:05-0:10

Visual: Side-profile tracking shot as Captain walks past a row of large retro computer stations, reel-to-reel style panels, switches, and glowing instrument clusters. He lightly brushes a hand across the edge of a chrome console as he passes. Soft practical reflections shimmer across his black uniform and silver trim.

Camera: Lateral tracking shot, smooth and measured.

Dialogue: “Longer models, bigger worlds, and enough artificial intelligence to make the universe feel rather small.”

SHOT 3 - 0:10-0:15

Visual: Captain stops at a large observation window or glowing circular display. He looks out thoughtfully, half in silhouette, ship lights glowing behind him. This should feel like a classic contemplative sci-fi image. He turns slightly back toward camera with a knowing expression.

Camera: Medium-wide, slow push in from behind and to the side.

Dialogue: “But don’t get too dazzled. Without a proper story, all that power is just pretty lights doing tricks in the dark.”

SHOT 4 - 0:15-0:20

Visual: Medium close-up as Captain resumes walking, now moving through a control room doorway with large blinking panels and oversized buttons in the foreground. He points lightly toward camera as he talks, casual and assured, like he’s sharing hard-earned wisdom.

Camera: Front-facing tracking medium close-up, slight handheld softness but still controlled.

Dialogue: “A machine can build the world… but it can’t tell us why we should care about it.”

SHOT 5 - 0:20-0:25

Visual: Captain enters the main bridge in a low-angle hero shot. The bridge is spacious, practical, and beautifully retro: cream consoles, chrome rails, oversized lit buttons, glowing instrument panels, and soft haze in the air. As he steps through the doorway, Fishman Mike and Ron are already there waiting for him near their stations. They both look toward him and give him a friendly thumbs up. Captain gives a small acknowledging grin as he keeps moving forward. After the thumbs up, Fishman Mike and Ron turn and begin working at the bridge controls in the background, adding life and movement behind him.

Camera: Low-angle slow push in, slightly epic, widening just enough to include Fishman Mike and Ron in the bridge space.

Dialogue: “That’s our job.” “And right now, when almost anything can be made, the rarest thing you can bring to it is yourself.”

SHOT 6 - 0:25-0:30

Visual: Tight medium close-up of Captain HaHaa near or beside the captain’s chair as he finishes his speech. Behind him, slightly out of focus, Fishman Mike and Ron continue working at their stations, pressing buttons, checking readouts, and moving with purpose. The bridge feels alive but never distracts from Captain. He leans toward camera slightly with a cheeky half-smile, warm eyes, full Captain HaHaa charisma.

Camera: Subtle push in, intimate and strong, with shallow depth of field so Captain stays dominant while Mike and Ron remain visible in the background.

Dialogue: “So be weird. Be honest. Make the thing only you would make.” “What a bloody good time to be alive.”

es.content:
Estilo: ciencia ficción retro cinematográfica, inspirada en las grandes películas espaciales de los años 70/80, efectos prácticos, composiciones simétricas, movimiento de cámara lento y deliberado, interiores de nave espacial en crema y cromo, botones grandes, paneles luminosos, lecturas analógicas, sutil grano de película, suave neblina, atmósfera dramática pero reflexiva. El Capitán HaHaa tiene encanto, desparpajo y calidez. Camina por su nave mientras recita un monólogo reflexivo con un acento australiano seguro. El tono es filosófico pero terrenal, y termina de forma esperanzadora y personal.

SHOT 1 - 0:00-0:05

Visual: Plano general simétrico de un largo pasillo de nave espacial en crema y cromo, con paneles de pared iluminados, botones parpadeantes y consolas retro integradas en las paredes. El Capitán HaHaa camina lentamente hacia cámara desde el extremo más lejano, con las manos relajadas detrás de la espalda al principio, tranquilo y reflexivo.

Camera: Dolly backward lento y centrado, muy suave, solemne y elegante.

Dialogue: “Well, here we are, mates, a brand-new age.”

SHOT 2 - 0:05-0:10

Visual: Plano de seguimiento de perfil lateral mientras el Capitán pasa junto a una fila de grandes estaciones informáticas retro, paneles estilo reel-to-reel, interruptores y conjuntos de instrumentos luminosos. Roza ligeramente con la mano el borde de una consola de cromo al pasar. Suaves reflejos prácticos brillan sobre su uniforme negro y los ribetes plateados.

Camera: Travelling lateral, suave y medido.

Dialogue: “Longer models, bigger worlds, and enough artificial intelligence to make the universe feel rather small.”

SHOT 3 - 0:10-0:15

Visual: El Capitán se detiene frente a una gran ventana de observación o una pantalla circular luminosa. Mira hacia afuera con aire pensativo, medio en silueta, con las luces de la nave brillando detrás de él. Debe sentirse como una imagen clásica y contemplativa de ciencia ficción. Se gira ligeramente de vuelta hacia cámara con una expresión cómplice.

Camera: Plano medio amplio, acercamiento lento desde atrás y de lado.

Dialogue: “But don’t get too dazzled. Without a proper story, all that power is just pretty lights doing tricks in the dark.”

SHOT 4 - 0:15-0:20

Visual: Plano medio corto mientras el Capitán reanuda la marcha, ahora atravesando una puerta de la sala de control con grandes paneles parpadeantes y botones sobredimensionados en primer plano. Señala ligeramente hacia cámara mientras habla, con naturalidad y seguridad, como si compartiera una sabiduría ganada con esfuerzo.

Camera: Plano medio corto en seguimiento frontal, con una ligera suavidad de handheld pero aún controlado.

Dialogue: “A machine can build the world… but it can’t tell us why we should care about it.”

SHOT 5 - 0:20-0:25

Visual: El Capitán entra en el puente principal en un plano heroico desde un ángulo bajo. El puente es espacioso, práctico y maravillosamente retro: consolas crema, barandillas de cromo, botones iluminados sobredimensionados, paneles de instrumentos resplandecientes y una suave neblina en el aire. Al cruzar la puerta, Fishman Mike y Ron ya están allí esperándolo cerca de sus estaciones. Ambos miran hacia él y le hacen un gesto amistoso de pulgar arriba. El Capitán responde con una pequeña sonrisa de reconocimiento mientras sigue avanzando. Después del pulgar arriba, Fishman Mike y Ron se giran y comienzan a trabajar en los controles del puente al fondo, aportando vida y movimiento detrás de él.

Camera: Acercamiento lento desde un ángulo bajo, ligeramente épico, abriéndose lo justo para incluir a Fishman Mike y Ron en el espacio del puente.

Dialogue: “That’s our job.” “And right now, when almost anything can be made, the rarest thing you can bring to it is yourself.”

SHOT 6 - 0:25-0:30

Visual: Plano medio corto y ajustado del Capitán HaHaa cerca o junto a la silla del capitán mientras termina su discurso. Detrás de él, ligeramente desenfocados, Fishman Mike y Ron siguen trabajando en sus estaciones, pulsando botones, revisando lecturas y moviéndose con propósito. El puente se siente vivo, pero nunca distrae del Capitán. Se inclina ligeramente hacia cámara con una media sonrisa traviesa, ojos cálidos, carisma total del Capitán HaHaa.

Camera: Acercamiento sutil, íntimo y potente, con poca profundidad de campo para que el Capitán siga dominando mientras Mike y Ron permanecen visibles al fondo.

Dialogue: “So be weird. Be honest. Make the thing only you would make.” “What a bloody good time to be alive.”

fr.content:
Style : science-fiction rétro cinématographique, inspiré des grands films spatiaux des années 1970/80, effets pratiques, compositions symétriques, mouvements de caméra lents et délibérés, intérieurs de vaisseau spatial crème et chrome, gros boutons, panneaux lumineux, affichages analogiques, léger grain de pellicule, voile doux, ambiance dramatique mais réfléchie. Captain HaHaa a du charme, de l’assurance et de la chaleur. Il traverse son vaisseau en livrant un monologue introspectif avec un accent australien assuré. Le ton est philosophique mais ancré dans le réel, avec une fin pleine d’espoir et personnelle.

SHOT 1 - 0:00-0:05

Visual: Plan large symétrique d’un long couloir de vaisseau spatial crème et chrome, avec des panneaux muraux lumineux, des boutons clignotants et des consoles rétro intégrées aux parois. Captain HaHaa marche lentement vers la caméra depuis l’extrémité du couloir, les mains d’abord posées librement derrière le dos, calme et réfléchi.

Camera: Travelling arrière lent et centré, très fluide, solennel et élégant.

Dialogue: “Well, here we are, mates, a brand-new age.”

SHOT 2 - 0:05-0:10

Visual: Plan de profil en travelling latéral alors que le Captain passe devant une rangée de grandes stations informatiques rétro, des panneaux de type reel-to-reel, des interrupteurs et des grappes d’instruments lumineux. Il effleure légèrement du bout de la main le bord d’une console en chrome en passant. De douces réflexions pratiques scintillent sur son uniforme noir et ses finitions argentées.

Camera: Travelling latéral, fluide et mesuré.

Dialogue: “Longer models, bigger worlds, and enough artificial intelligence to make the universe feel rather small.”

SHOT 3 - 0:10-0:15

Visual: Le Captain s’arrête devant une grande baie d’observation ou un affichage circulaire lumineux. Il regarde au loin avec gravité, à moitié en silhouette, les lumières du vaisseau brillant derrière lui. L’image doit évoquer un classique de la science-fiction contemplative. Il se tourne légèrement vers la caméra avec une expression complice.

Camera: Plan moyen-large, lent push-in depuis l’arrière et le côté.

Dialogue: “But don’t get too dazzled. Without a proper story, all that power is just pretty lights doing tricks in the dark.”

SHOT 4 - 0:15-0:20

Visual: Plan rapproché moyen alors que le Captain reprend sa marche, traversant maintenant l’encadrement d’une salle de contrôle avec de grands panneaux clignotants et des boutons surdimensionnés au premier plan. Il pointe légèrement vers la caméra en parlant, détendu et assuré, comme s’il partageait une sagesse durement acquise.

Camera: Plan rapproché moyen en travelling frontal, avec une légère douceur handheld mais toujours maîtrisée.

Dialogue: “A machine can build the world… but it can’t tell us why we should care about it.”

SHOT 5 - 0:20-0:25

Visual: Le Captain entre sur la passerelle principale dans un plan héroïque en contre-plongée. La passerelle est spacieuse, fonctionnelle et magnifiquement rétro : consoles crème, rampes en chrome, gros boutons lumineux, panneaux d’instruments brillants et légère brume dans l’air. En franchissant l’embrasure, Fishman Mike et Ron sont déjà là, l’attendant près de leurs postes. Ils se tournent vers lui et lui adressent un pouce levé amical. Le Captain esquisse un petit sourire de reconnaissance tout en continuant d’avancer. Après le pouce levé, Fishman Mike et Ron se retournent et commencent à travailler sur les commandes de la passerelle en arrière-plan, apportant vie et mouvement derrière lui.

Camera: Lent push-in en contre-plongée, légèrement épique, s’élargissant juste assez pour inclure Fishman Mike et Ron dans l’espace de la passerelle.

Dialogue: “That’s our job.” “And right now, when almost anything can be made, the rarest thing you can bring to it is yourself.”

SHOT 6 - 0:25-0:30

Visual: Plan rapproché moyen serré de Captain HaHaa près ou à côté du fauteuil du capitaine alors qu’il termine son discours. Derrière lui, légèrement flous, Fishman Mike et Ron continuent de travailler à leurs postes, appuyant sur des boutons, vérifiant les relevés et bougeant avec détermination. La passerelle est vivante sans jamais détourner l’attention du Captain. Il se penche légèrement vers la caméra avec un demi-sourire malicieux, le regard chaleureux, tout le charisme de Captain HaHaa.

Camera: Push-in subtil, intime et puissant, avec une faible profondeur de champ pour que le Captain reste dominant tandis que Mike et Ron demeurent visibles à l’arrière-plan.

Dialogue: “So be weird. Be honest. Make the thing only you would make.” “What a bloody good time to be alive.”

ja.content:
スタイル：シネマティックなレトロSF。1970〜80年代の壮大な宇宙映画に着想を得た、実用効果、対称的な構図、ゆっくりと意図的なカメラ移動、クリームとクロームの宇宙船内装、大きなボタン、発光パネル、アナログ表示、さりげないフィルムグレイン、柔らかな霞、ドラマチックでありながら思慮深いムード。Captain HaHaa は、魅力、 swagger、そして温かみを備えている。彼は自分の船内を歩きながら、自信に満ちたオーストラリア訛りで内省的なモノローグを語る。トーンは哲学的でありつつ地に足がついていて、最後は希望に満ちた個人的な余韻で締めくくられる。

SHOT 1 - 0:00-0:05

Visual: 長いクリームとクロームの宇宙船の通路を捉えた、広角の対称ショット。壁には発光するパネル、点滅するボタン、レトロなコンソールが埋め込まれている。Captain HaHaa は奥の端からゆっくりとカメラに向かって歩いてくる。最初は両手をゆるく背中に回し、落ち着いていて思索的。

Camera: 中央を保ったゆっくりとした後退ドリー。非常になめらかで、威厳があり優雅。

Dialogue: “Well, here we are, mates, a brand-new age.”

SHOT 2 - 0:05-0:10

Visual: Captain が、大きなレトロなコンピューターステーション、リール・トゥ・リール風のパネル、スイッチ、発光する計器群の列を横切るサイドプロファイルのトラッキングショット。通り過ぎる際、クロームのコンソールの縁に軽く手を触れる。彼の黒い制服とシルバーのトリムには、柔らかな実用反射がきらめく。

Camera: 横方向のトラッキングショット。なめらかで、落ち着いた動き。

Dialogue: “Longer models, bigger worlds, and enough artificial intelligence to make the universe feel rather small.”

SHOT 3 - 0:10-0:15

Visual: Captain が大きな観測窓、または発光する円形ディスプレイの前で立ち止まる。彼は思慮深く外を見つめ、半分シルエットになり、背後では船内のライトが輝いている。クラシックな内省的SFのイメージとして感じられること。彼は少しだけカメラの方へ振り向き、意味ありげな表情を見せる。

Camera: ミディアムワイド。後方と斜めからゆっくり寄る。

Dialogue: “But don’t get too dazzled. Without a proper story, all that power is just pretty lights doing tricks in the dark.”

SHOT 4 - 0:15-0:20

Visual: Captain が再び歩き出すミディアムクローズアップ。前景には大きな点滅パネルと特大ボタンがあり、彼は制御室のドアを抜けて進んでいく。話しながら、気軽で確信に満ちた様子でカメラに軽く指を向ける。まるで苦労して得た知恵を分かち合っているように。

Camera: 正面からのトラッキング・ミディアムクローズアップ。わずかに手持ちの柔らかさがあるが、制御は保たれている。

Dialogue: “A machine can build the world… but it can’t tell us why we should care about it.”

SHOT 5 - 0:20-0:25

Visual: Captain がローアングルのヒーローショットでメインブリッジに入る。ブリッジは広々としていて、実用的で、美しくレトロ：クリーム色のコンソール、クロームの手すり、特大の発光ボタン、輝く計器パネル、そして空気中の柔らかな霞。彼がドアをくぐると、Fishman Mike と Ron はすでにそれぞれの持ち場の近くで彼を待っている。二人は彼の方を見て、親しげに親指を立てる。Captain はそれに小さく応える笑みを見せつつ、そのまま前へ進み続ける。親指を立てた後、Fishman Mike と Ron は振り返ってブリッジの操作盤を背景で動かし始め、彼の後ろに生命感と動きを加える。

Camera: ローアングルのゆっくりとした押し寄り。やや壮大で、Fishman Mike と Ron がブリッジ空間に入る程度に少しだけ画角を広げる。

Dialogue: “That’s our job.” “And right now, when almost anything can be made, the rarest thing you can bring to it is yourself.”

SHOT 6 - 0:25-0:30

스타일: 1970~80년대의 웅장한 우주 영화에서 영감을 받은 시네마틱 레트로 SF, 실용 특수효과, 대칭적인 구도, 느리고 의도적인 카메라 움직임, 크림색과 크롬으로 마감된 우주선 내부, 큰 버튼, 빛나는 패널, 아날로그 계기판, 은은한 필름 그레인, 부드러운 헤이즈, 극적이면서도 사려 깊은 분위기. Captain HaHaa는 매력, 자신감 넘치는 태도, 따뜻함을 지녔다. 그는 자신감 있는 호주 억양으로 성찰적인 독백을 들려주며 우주선을 걸어간다. 톤은 철학적이지만 현실에 발을 딛고 있으며, 희망적이고 개인적인 여운으로 끝난다.

SHOT 1 - 0:00-0:05

Visual: 길고 크림색과 크롬으로 된 우주선 복도를 넓고 대칭적으로 잡은 샷. 벽면에는 빛나는 패널, 깜빡이는 버튼, 벽에 내장된 레트로 콘솔이 있다. Captain HaHaa는 복도 끝에서 카메라를 향해 천천히 걸어오며, 처음에는 손을 느슨하게 등 뒤에 둔 채 차분하고 사색적인 분위기를 풍긴다.

Camera: 중앙을 기준으로 천천히 뒤로 이동하는 dolly, 매우 부드럽고 위엄 있으며 우아하게.

Dialogue: “Well, here we are, mates, a brand-new age.”

SHOT 2 - 0:05-0:10

Visual: Captain이 큰 레트로 컴퓨터 스테이션, 릴투릴 스타일 패널, 스위치, 빛나는 계기 클러스터가 줄지어 있는 옆을 지나가는 측면 프로필 트래킹 샷. 그는 지나가며 크롬 콘솔 가장자리를 손으로 가볍게 스친다. 부드러운 실용 조명이 그의 검은 유니폼과 은색 트림 위로 은은하게 반짝인다.

Camera: 측면 트래킹 샷, 부드럽고 절제된 움직임.

Dialogue: “Longer models, bigger worlds, and enough artificial intelligence to make the universe feel rather small.”

SHOT 3 - 0:10-0:15

Visual: Captain이 큰 관측창 또는 빛나는 원형 디스플레이 앞에서 멈춘다. 그는 사려 깊게 바깥을 바라보며, 반쯤 실루엣으로 보이고 뒤로는 우주선 조명이 빛난다. 고전적인 사색형 SF 이미지처럼 느껴져야 한다. 그는 아는 듯한 표정으로 카메라 쪽을 살짝 돌아본다.

Camera: 미디엄 와이드, 뒤와 옆에서 천천히 밀고 들어오는 push-in.

Dialogue: “But don’t get too dazzled. Without a proper story, all that power is just pretty lights doing tricks in the dark.”

SHOT 4 - 0:15-0:20

Visual: Captain이 다시 걸음을 옮기며, 전면에는 큰 깜빡이는 패널과 커다란 버튼이 보이는 제어실 출입구를 지나가는 미디엄 클로즈업. 그는 말하면서 카메라를 향해 가볍게 손가락으로 가리키며, 오랜 경험에서 나온 지혜를 나누는 듯한 편안하고 확신에 찬 태도를 보인다.

Camera: 정면을 향한 트래킹 미디엄 클로즈업, 약간의 핸드헬드 같은 부드러움이 있지만 여전히 통제된 느낌.

Dialogue: “A machine can build the world… but it can’t tell us why we should care about it.”

SHOT 5 - 0:20-0:25

Captain은 그들을 알아보는 듯 작은 미소를 지으며 계속 앞으로 나아간다. 엄지를 치켜든 뒤 Fishman Mike와 Ron은 돌아서서 배경에서 브리지 조작 장치를 다루기 시작해, 그의 뒤에 생동감과 움직임을 더한다.

Camera: 로우 앵글의 느린 push-in, 약간 서사적이면서도 브리지 공간 안에 Fishman Mike와 Ron이 들어오도록 충분히 넓게.

Dialogue: “That’s our job.” “And right now, when almost anything can be made, the rarest thing you can bring to it is yourself.”

SHOT 6 - 0:25-0:30

Visual: Captain HaHaa가 연설을 마무리하는 순간, 캡틴 체어 근처 또는 옆에서 잡은 타이트한 미디엄 클로즈업. 뒤쪽에는 약간 흐릿하게 Fishman Mike와 Ron이 각자의 자리에서 계속 일하며 버튼을 누르고, 계기판을 확인하고, 목적 있게 움직인다. 브리지는 살아 움직이지만 Captain에게서 시선을 빼앗지 않는다. 그는 장난기 어린 반쯤 웃는 미소와 따뜻한 눈빛으로 카메라 쪽으로 살짝 몸을 기울이며, Captain HaHaa 특유의 매력을 온전히 드러낸다.

Camera: 은근한 push-in, 친밀하면서도 강한 느낌. 얕은 심도로 Captain이 중심을 유지하고 Mike와 Ron은 배경에서 보이도록.

Dialogue: “So be weird. Be honest. Make the thing only you would make.” “What a bloody good time to be alive.”

pt.content:
Estilo: ficção científica retrô cinematográfica, inspirada nos grandes filmes espaciais dos anos 1970/80, efeitos práticos, composições simétricas, movimento de câmera lento e deliberado, interiores de nave em creme e cromado, botões grandes, painéis luminosos, leituras analógicas, leve granulação de filme, névoa suave, clima dramático, mas reflexivo. O Capitão HaHaa tem charme, presença e calor humano. Ele caminha pela nave enquanto entrega um monólogo reflexivo com um forte sotaque australiano. O tom é filosófico, mas pé no chão, terminando de forma esperançosa e pessoal.

SHOT 1 - 0:00-0:05

Visual: Plano geral simétrico de um longo corredor de nave espacial em creme e cromado, com painéis de parede luminosos, botões piscando e consoles retrô embutidos nas paredes. O Capitão HaHaa caminha lentamente em direção à câmera, vindo do fundo do corredor, com as mãos soltas atrás das costas no início, calmo e reflexivo.

Camera: Dolly backward lento e centralizado, muito suave, solene e elegante.

Dialogue: “Well, here we are, mates, a brand-new age.”

SHOT 2 - 0:05-0:10

Visual: Plano de acompanhamento em perfil lateral enquanto o Capitão passa por uma fileira de grandes estações de computador retrô, painéis no estilo reel-to-reel, interruptores e conjuntos de instrumentos luminosos. Ele passa de leve a mão pela borda de um console cromado ao atravessar. Reflexos suaves e práticos cintilam sobre seu uniforme preto e os detalhes prateados.

Camera: Travelling lateral, suave e preciso.

Dialogue: “Longer models, bigger worlds, and enough artificial intelligence to make the universe feel rather small.”

SHOT 3 - 0:10-0:15

Visual: O Capitão para diante de uma grande janela de observação ou de um display circular luminoso. Ele olha para fora de forma contemplativa, meio em silhueta, com as luzes da nave brilhando atrás dele. A imagem deve remeter a um clássico momento contemplativo de ficção científica. Ele se vira levemente de volta para a câmera com uma expressão cúmplice.

Camera: Plano médio-aberto, push in lento por trás e de lado.

Dialogue: “But don’t get too dazzled. Without a proper story, all that power is just pretty lights doing tricks in the dark.”

SHOT 4 - 0:15-0:20

Visual: Plano médio fechado enquanto o Capitão volta a caminhar, agora passando por uma porta da sala de controle com grandes painéis piscando e botões oversized em primeiro plano. Ele aponta levemente para a câmera enquanto fala, casual e seguro, como se estivesse compartilhando uma sabedoria conquistada com esforço.

Camera: Plano médio fechado em tracking frontal, com leve suavidade de handheld, mas ainda controlado.

Dialogue: “A machine can build the world… but it can’t tell us why we should care about it.”

SHOT 5 - 0:20-0:25

Visual: O Capitão entra na ponte principal em um plano heroico de baixo para cima. A ponte é espaçosa, prática e lindamente retrô: consoles em creme, corrimãos cromados, botões iluminados oversized, painéis de instrumentos brilhando e uma névoa suave no ar. Ao atravessar a porta, Fishman Mike e Ron já estão lá, esperando por ele perto de suas estações. Os dois olham para ele e fazem um joinha amigável. O Capitão responde com um pequeno sorriso de reconhecimento enquanto continua avançando. Depois do joinha, Fishman Mike e Ron se viram e começam a trabalhar nos controles da ponte ao fundo, acrescentando vida e movimento atrás dele.

Camera: Push in lento em ângulo baixo, levemente épico, abrindo o suficiente para incluir Fishman Mike e Ron no espaço da ponte.

Dialogue: “That’s our job.” “And right now, when almost anything can be made, the rarest thing you can bring to it is yourself.”

SHOT 6 - 0:25-0:30

Visual: Plano médio fechado do Capitão HaHaa perto ou ao lado da cadeira do capitão enquanto ele encerra seu discurso. Atrás dele, levemente fora de foco, Fishman Mike e Ron continuam trabalhando em suas estações, apertando botões, conferindo leituras e se movendo com propósito. A ponte parece viva, mas sem jamais desviar a atenção do Capitão. Ele se inclina levemente em direção à câmera com um meio sorriso maroto, olhos calorosos, com todo o carisma do Capitão HaHaa.

Camera: Push in sutil, íntimo e forte, com profundidade de campo rasa para manter o Capitão em destaque enquanto Mike e Ron permanecem visíveis ao fundo.

Dialogue: “So be weird. Be honest. Make the thing only you would make.” “What a bloody good time to be alive.”

风格：电影感复古科幻，灵感来自 20 世纪 70/80 年代宏大的太空电影，实景特效，对称构图，缓慢而克制的镜头运动，奶油色与镀铬质感的飞船内饰，大按钮、发光面板、模拟仪表读数，轻微胶片颗粒，柔和薄雾，氛围戏剧化但富有思考感。Captain HaHaa 兼具魅力、潇洒与温暖。他一边在飞船中行走，一边用自信的澳式口音发表一段富有反思意味的独白。整体语气哲思而落地，结尾温暖、个人化且充满希望。

SHOT 1 - 0:00-0:05

Visual: 宽幅对称镜头，展示一条漫长的奶油色与镀铬飞船走廊，墙面发光面板、闪烁按钮，以及嵌入墙体的复古控制台。Captain HaHaa 从远端缓慢朝镜头走来，起初双手随意背在身后，神情平静而沉思。

Camera: 缓慢居中的后退推轨，极其平滑，庄重而优雅。

Dialogue: “Well, here we are, mates, a brand-new age.”

SHOT 2 - 0:05-0:10

Visual: 侧面跟拍镜头，Captain 走过一排大型复古电脑工作站、卷带式面板、开关和发光仪表组。他经过时，轻轻用手拂过一只镀铬控制台的边缘。柔和的实景反光在他的黑色制服和银色镶边上微微闪烁。

Camera: 横向跟拍，平稳而有节奏。

Dialogue: “Longer models, bigger worlds, and enough artificial intelligence to make the universe feel rather small.”

SHOT 3 - 0:10-0:15

Visual: Captain 停在一扇大型观察窗或发光的圆形显示屏前。他若有所思地向外望去，半身处于剪影中，身后船内灯光微微发亮。这一幕应呈现经典的沉思型科幻画面。他略微转身看向镜头，神情意味深长。

Camera: 中远景，从后侧缓慢推近。

Dialogue: “But don’t get too dazzled. Without a proper story, all that power is just pretty lights doing tricks in the dark.”

SHOT 4 - 0:15-0:20

Visual: 中近景，Captain 继续前行，穿过控制室门口，前景可见大型闪烁面板和超大按钮。他说话时轻轻朝镜头点指，举止随意而笃定，像是在分享来之不易的经验。

Camera: 正面跟拍中近景，带一点手持感的柔和，但整体仍然受控。

Dialogue: “A machine can build the world… but it can’t tell us why we should care about it.”

SHOT 5 - 0:20-0:25

Visual: Captain 以低角度英雄镜头进入主舰桥。舰桥空间宽敞、实用而又极具复古美感：奶油色控制台、镀铬扶手、超大发光按钮、发光仪表面板，以及空气中柔和的薄雾。当他穿过门口时，Fishman Mike 和 Ron 已经在各自岗位附近等着他。两人都朝他看去，并友好地竖起大拇指。Captain 一边继续向前走，一边回以一个小小的会意笑容。竖完大拇指后，Fishman Mike 和 Ron 转身开始在背景中操作舰桥控制台，为他身后增添生气与动感。

Camera: 低角度缓慢推近，略带史诗感，画面适度拉宽，以便将 Fishman Mike 和 Ron 也纳入舰桥空间。

Dialogue: “That’s our job.” “And right now, when almost anything can be made, the rarest thing you can bring to it is yourself.”

SHOT 6 - 0:25-0:30

Visual: Captain HaHaa 在舰长椅附近或旁边的紧凑中近景，完成他的讲话。身后稍微虚焦处，Fishman Mike 和 Ron 继续在各自岗位上工作，按按钮、查看读数、专注地移动。舰桥充满生命力，但始终不会分散对 Captain 的注意。他微微向镜头倾身，带着一丝俏皮的半笑，目光温暖，尽显 Captain HaHaa 的魅力。

Camera: 细微推近，亲近而有力量，浅景深让 Captain 始终占据主导，Mike 和 Ron 仍可在背景中看见。

Dialogue: “So be weird. Be honest. Make the thing only you would make.” “What a bloody good time to be alive.”

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
